parameters.query:
SELECT w.*,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'listing_languages') AS listing_languages,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'owner_email') AS owner_email,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM watches w
WHERE NOT w.listings_done
  AND w.status = 'in_stock'
  AND w.auth_status IN ('ai_checked', 'watchmaker_verified')
ORDER BY w.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH saved AS (
    INSERT INTO listings (watch_id, language, title, description)
    SELECT $1::INT, x.language, x.title, x.description
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(language TEXT, title TEXT, description TEXT)
    ON CONFLICT (watch_id, language) DO UPDATE
    SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description
    RETURNING watch_id
)
UPDATE watches SET listings_done = TRUE
WHERE id = $1::INT
RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## Multilingual listings
For every checked watch without listings, Claude writes a title and description in each language from the `listing_languages` setting (default: English, Arabic, French, German, Chinese). They are saved in `listings` and emailed to you for copy-paste.
